create_WalkerBase_robot: create a WalkerBase robot instance with custom XML file, action dimensions, and power settings
apply_action_joints: apply clipped motor torque actions to ordered joints using the apply_action method
calc_state_observations: calculate the robot state vector including joint positions, speeds, body pose, and feet contact
create_HumanoidFlagrun_env: create a HumanoidFlagrun environment that repositions a flag target for the humanoid to chase
calc_potential_reward: calculate the potential field reward based on walking distance to target divided by scene timestep
